rationale: The agent verified identity by matching the provided email via tools to a single user, retrieved the user and order details, and listed the items. It stated the exact items to be returned (everything except the espresso machine) and the refund method, then explicitly asked for confirmation before performing the return. After receiving “yes,” it used the return tool with item IDs corresponding to the non-coffee-machine items and confirmed the return submission and refund destination. Actions were confined to the authenticated user’s account. While the tool response was truncated and didn’t visibly show order status, the agent had inspected order details beforehand and used the appropriate return tool, implying eligibility. No unsupported claims or policy violations are evident.
